findings.title: The wire's prompt and objective reach the model as the trusted system instruction block with no authority check; the only digest verifier returns early for both
findings.recommendation: Extend the existing case in verify_manifest_digest! (situation_request.rb:754-769) to cover prompt and objective, or move their verification out of the @artifact_store-conditional path at :529 so it runs before execute_turn. Reuse the IntentCatalog.verify_wire pattern; no new class and no new digest domain.

findings.title: Situation recall crosses situation_type boundaries (the SQL boundary omits entity_id, the Ruby exclusion runs after the shortlist) and the divergence survives to automatic promotion because the projection digest does not bind the scopes
findings.recommendation: Add AND i.scopes_entity_id <> ? to situation_boundary (memory_store.rb:633-642) using the caller's entity_id that situation_caller already supplies (situation_recaller.rb:69-76), and make Projection#initialize verify digest over {statement, scopes, provenance} (situation_recall.rb:28-33). Two one-line changes at existing seams.

findings.title: EpisodeStreamAdapter#typed_code can raise (NoMethodError/TypeError) instead of falling back when a Tamoz::-prefixed constant resolves to a non-Module
findings.recommendation: One line at episode_stream.rb:264: return "graph_step_failed" unless klass.is_a?(Module) && klass.const_defined?(:CATEGORY, false); widen the rescue to NameError, NoMethodError, TypeError. No new machinery.

findings.title: A wrong-shaped tool_catalog_json crashes the tool node with NoMethodError instead of the node's own ProtocolError refusal
findings.recommendation: Guard the shape before mapping at episode_nodes.rb:604-605: raise ProtocolError, "episode_tool/catalog_malformed" unless parsed.is_a?(Array) && parsed.all? { |e| e.is_a?(Hash) }. Two lines at an existing seam.

findings.title: The episode fail path can leave Execute without any terminal: stream.events is iterated outside the rescue that fail_stream lives in
findings.recommendation: Move the yielding inside the begin block at situation_request.rb:404-409 (or wrap fail_stream itself) so a terminal is always yielded. One structural line; no new class.

findings.title: The evidence truncation flag is verified and then dropped before the model sees the tool result
findings.recommendation: Add "truncated" => result.fetch("truncated", false) to the one hash at episode_frame_builder.rb:159-166. No test asserts either way.

findings.title: The shipped launcher binds an in-memory artifact store, so a PRODUCED terminal's manifest stops resolving across a worker restart
findings.recommendation: None required now; the store documents itself as mechanism-not-policy (artifact_store.rb:14-16). The deployment must bind an implementation whose lifetime matches the durable verification rows that cite the manifest.

findings.title: evidence_tools_endpoint is admitted unvalidated and dialled verbatim over an insecure, scheme-agnostic channel
findings.recommendation: None required for authority: the endpoint and the capability_token ride the same request, so a request-scoped peer gains no authority it did not already hold. Stating the deployment precondition where the socket is described would suffice.

findings.title: EpisodeRunner still folds six concerns and retains artifact retention (residue of top-100 016's [PLACE]); EpisodeModelEventProjection duplicates the wire event vocabulary through a discarded StreamPart intermediate
findings.recommendation: None now. This is the already-recorded ownership debt (top-100 016 [PLACE], still PARTIAL) restated with current line numbers; the smallest credible step remains moving retention onto the artifact-store seam.
